channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News and other tool sources, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: ToleHub
item.description: Invoices, ROI math, and data format conversions all run online — no install, just open and use.

item.title: KinlorAI
item.description: Make AI images and videos in your browser with templates and free media tools, no app-switching needed.

item.title: MonsterX Ai: Free AI Tools for Coding, Writing and Productivity
item.description: A free AI platform with tools for coding assistance, Python error fixing, code explanations, regex generation and more, with selected tools free and no sign-up.

item.title: Tempboxy
item.description: A disposable inbox that opens instantly and pulls verification codes out automatically — handy when you don't want to share your real email.

item.title: RandTools
item.description: Random pickers for League of Legends, Pokémon, Dead by Daylight and more — settle your hero or loadout by luck before the match starts.

item.title: Learn Arduino: Interactive 3D Arduino Uno Simulator
item.description: Tinker with a virtual Arduino Uno in your browser — rotate the board, tweak components and watch LEDs blink across 16 interactive lessons, the first three free.

item.title: Show HN: Top10Q – a to-do list app that does not create more work for you
item.description: A to-do list app that keeps your focus on the ten things that matter most each day, automating and simplifying tasks so the list itself stops being extra work.

item.title: Show HN: Who Owns America – Largest US landholders from public tax rolls
item.description: An interactive map of America's largest landholders, built from public tax rolls — zoom in and see who really owns the land around you.

item.title: Offthread – AI Chat That Redacts Personal Details in the Browser
item.description: An AI chat that redacts personal details in your browser before anything is sent, so private information never leaves your device.

item.title: Real algebraic curves toy
item.description: Drag the red dots to see the real algebraic curve through them in real time, pick from preset curve families or type in your own polynomial — a hands-on math visualization toy.

item.title: Get Hotel Lobby
item.description: Upload two photos and get a 15-second AI video of a hotel lobby — a quick way to preview a space before you build or book it.

item.title: Veol AI
item.description: A browser-based AI creative studio for images with Nano Banana and videos with Seedance and Veo, with the credit cost shown before you generate and no charge when a generation fails.

item.title: VectorDose
item.description: Search 14,800+ brand logos and download them free as SVG or transparent PNG, with official brand colors — ready to drop into designs and decks.

item.title: No Scrubs Dance AI
item.description: Swap the lead dancer — or the whole trio — in a fixed 15-second dance clip, no editing timeline required.

item.title: Word2MD
item.description: Turn Word documents into Markdown right in your browser — a quick format fix before publishing docs or blog posts.

item.title: BGChanger AI
item.description: Remove or swap a video background with one click — no green screen, no manual masking.

item.title: Aure AI
item.description: Feed it a rough idea and get back a clear, structured AI prompt — ask once, get it right.

item.title: OBD Lens
item.description: Look up what an OBD2 fault code means and inspect recorded scan data — understand the problem before heading to the shop.

item.title: Debt Payoff Plan
item.description: Enter your monthly budget to compare snowball vs. avalanche payoff strategies, with a month-by-month forecast of when you'll be debt-free.

item.title: EdgeBreak
item.description: Scan US stocks and spot chart patterns with AI — a fast way for traders to find tickers worth a closer look.
